tools.name: list_personalizable_products
tools.description: List WELANDA products that can be personalized, with live pricing and the full engraving template (zones + constraints). Call this FIRST so you know each zone's size, allowed fonts, character limits and minimum text size before building a design.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Upload a logo/image (base64, PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG, max 5 MB) for use in a design. Returns an assetId; reference it in an image object as { origin:"minio", bucket:"draft", key:"<assetId>" }. Images are re-encoded to PNG server-side (metadata stripped). No URLs — base64 only.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Create a design draft for a product from a DesignDocumentV3. Returns status "valid" with a signed handoffUrl, or status "invalid" with a list of {path, code, message} errors you can fix and resubmit via update_design. Invalid drafts are still saved so you can iterate.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render watermarked PNG preview(s) of a VALID design (all zones, or one via zoneId). Returns preview image URLs plus the watermarked preview as inline image content (one per zone) - show it to the user. If the render queue is busy it returns {status:"pending", retryAfterSec} - retry after that delay.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Fetch a draft's current document, status, version, claimed flag, handoff link and previews by its designId.

tools.name: update_design
tools.description: Replace a draft's design with a new full DesignDocumentV3 (version increments, previews invalidated). Same validation as create_design. Fails with CLAIMED once the customer has opened and claimed the draft in the editor.

tools.name: get_handoff_link
tools.description: Get the signed handoff deeplink plus a short English summary to present to the customer ("Engraving … on … Personalization +…€"). The customer fine-tunes and checks out themselves.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_design · Private data: get_design · Public sink: upload_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_design · Private data: get_design · Public sink: upload_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
